hundred_years_war = {
	monthly_spawn_chance = monthly_spawn_chance_unique
	hint_tag = hint_hundred_years_war

	can_start = {
		always = no # ANTIQVITAS mounted-system quarantine
		country_exists = c:DUMMY
		country_exists = c:DUMMY
		current_date > 476.9.4

		c:DUMMY = {
			has_ruler = yes
		}
		c:DUMMY = {
			has_ruler = yes
		}

		custom_tooltip = {
			text = matter_of_robert_is_settled_tt
			OR = {
				c:DUMMY = {
					OR = {
						has_variable = robert_the_fugitive_flag
						has_variable = france_no_robert_interest
					}
				}
				character:eng_robert_iii_artois ?= { is_alive = no }
			}
		}
	}

	can_end = {
		hundred_years_war_unified_requirements = yes
	}

	visible = {
		always = no # ANTIQVITAS mounted-system quarantine
		capital ?= { sub_continent = sub_continent:western_europe }
	}


	on_start = {
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { tag = ENG }
				NOT = { tag = FRA }
				exists = capital
				capital.sub_continent = sub_continent:western_europe
			}

			trigger_event_non_silently = hundred_years_war.1
		}
		c:DUMMY = {
			trigger_event_non_silently = hundred_years_war.2
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = hundred_years_war_impact years = -1 mode = add }
			add_opinion_mutual_effect = {
				modifier = opinion_hyw_enemies
				target = c:DUMMY
			}
		}
		c:DUMMY = {
			trigger_event_non_silently = hundred_years_war.3
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = hundred_years_war_impact years = -1 mode = add }
		}
	}

	on_monthly = {
		random_list = {
			1 = { c:DUMMY = { trigger_event_non_silently = hundred_years_war.211 } }
			1 = { c:DUMMY = { trigger_event_non_silently = hundred_years_war.211 } }
			99 = {}
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = hundred_years_war_monthly
			random_list = {

				# give cb to england
				20 = {
					trigger = {
						c:DUMMY ?= {
							NOT = {	has_casus_belli_on = c:DUMMY	}
							NOT = {	has_truce_with = c:DUMMY	}
							NOT = {	is_at_war_with = c:DUMMY	}
							has_ruler = yes
						}
					}
					c:DUMMY = {	trigger_event_non_silently = hundred_years_war.10 }
				}

				# give cb to france
				20 = {
					trigger = {
						c:DUMMY ?= {
							NOT = {	has_casus_belli_on = c:DUMMY	}
							NOT = {	has_truce_with = c:DUMMY	}
							NOT = {	is_at_war_with = c:DUMMY	}
							has_ruler = yes
						}
					}
					c:DUMMY = {	trigger_event_non_silently = hundred_years_war.11 }
				}


				# attempt a war for england
				20 = {
					trigger = {
						c:DUMMY ?= {
							has_casus_belli_on = c:DUMMY
							NOT = {	has_truce_with = c:DUMMY	}
							NOT = {	is_at_war_with = c:DUMMY	}
							at_war = no
							manpower_percentage > 0.75
							war_exhaustion_percentage < 0.1
							relative_strength = {
								target = c:DUMMY
								value > 0.45
							}
						}
					}
					c:DUMMY = { trigger_event_non_silently = hundred_years_war.20 }
				}

				# attempt a war for france
				20 = {
					trigger = {
						c:DUMMY ?= {
							has_casus_belli_on = c:DUMMY
							NOT = {	has_truce_with = c:DUMMY	}
							NOT = {	is_at_war_with = c:DUMMY	}
							at_war = no
							manpower_percentage > 0.75
							war_exhaustion_percentage < 0.1
							relative_strength = {
								target = c:DUMMY
								value > 0.45
							}
						}
					}
					c:DUMMY = { trigger_event_non_silently = hundred_years_war.21 }
				}
				200 = {}

			}
		}
	}


	on_ended = {
		c:DUMMY = {
			remove_country_modifier = hundred_years_war_impact
			remove_opinion_mutual_effect = {
				modifier = opinion_hyw_enemies
				target = c:DUMMY
			}
			remove_casus_belli = {
				target = c:DUMMY
				type = casus_belli:cb_hundred_years_war
			}
		}
		c:DUMMY = {
			remove_country_modifier = hundred_years_war_impact
			remove_casus_belli = {
				target = c:DUMMY
				type = casus_belli:cb_hundred_years_war_fra
			}
		}


		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					c:DUMMY = { is_subject_or_below_of = c:DUMMY }
					NOT = { country_exists = c:DUMMY }
					c:DUMMY = {
						in_union_with = c:DUMMY
						union ?= {
							international_organization_has_policy = policy:union_establish_seniority_policy
							country_has_special_status = {
								type = special_status:senior_partner
								country = c:DUMMY
							}
						}
					}
					region:france_region = {
						any_ownable_location_in_region = {
							owner = {
								top_overlord_or_this ?= c:DUMMY
							}
							count > 130
						}
					}
				}
			}
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					capital.sub_continent = sub_continent:western_europe
				}
				trigger_event_non_silently = hundred_years_war.100
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					NOT = { country_exists = c:DUMMY }
					AND = {
						region:france_region = {
							any_ownable_location_in_region = {
								owner = {
									top_overlord_or_this ?= c:DUMMY
								}
								count < 4
							}
						}
						region:france_region = {
							any_ownable_location_in_region = {
								owner = {
									this = c:DUMMY
								}
								count > 200
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { tag = FRA }
					capital.sub_continent = sub_continent:western_europe
				}
				trigger_event_non_silently = hundred_years_war.101
			}
			c:DUMMY = { trigger_event_non_silently = flavor_fra.26 }
		}
		else = {
			every_country = {
				limit = { can_see_situation = situation:hundred_years_war }
				trigger_event_non_silently = hundred_years_war.1537
			}
		}

	}

				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = this_is_ally_of_england_tt
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				owner ?= {
					is_allied_with = { target = c:DUMMY }
					is_allied_with = { target = c:DUMMY }
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = this_is_ally_of_both_tt
